## The December 6 Deadline That’s Driving the Timeline

The reason this story has a hard clock attached to it is simple corporate housekeeping. Tesla’s 2026 annual general meeting must be held no later than December 6, 2026, according to the Barclays analysis cited across TipRanks and other outlets. That date is not speculative; it is a function of Tesla’s bylaws and prior meeting dates, which set an outer boundary for when the 2026 AGM has to take place.
